_comment: chassis-delegation per-repo config. Every key is optional. Precedence: built-in defaults < this file < /config settings (maps merge per key). Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.
_gateMap: Brief gate= id -> the command the verifier re-runs in the worker's own worktree, by argv (no shell). {files} is the changed-files list (one path a line); chain with ' && '. Example: {"test": "npm test", "lint": "npx eslint --max-warnings 0 {files}"}. An id the map lacks is reported 'gate not re-run' (unverified), never run raw.
_agentTypes: Card domain -> the subagent type /dispatch spawns (the Agent tool subagent_type). A domain not named here runs on a subagent type of its own name when the session offers one, else general-purpose. Example: {"ops": "general-purpose", "web": "frontend"}.
_tierMap: Card tier -> model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus; fable is rewritten to opus). Always an alias, so model releases move the ladder.
_domains: The card domains /dispatch accepts; the branch is agent/<domain>/<id>.
_maxWorkers: Briefed workers at once; a briefed spawn past it waits in a queue.
_worktreeRoot: Folder for the workers' worktrees; empty = sibling folders <repo>-<id>.
_briefTemplate: A brief body template file (absolute path); empty = the mod's hooks/templates/brief.md.
_briefExtra: Repo-specific lines added to every brief (setup steps, conventions, things never to do).
briefExtra: This repo IS the chassis-delegation mod. Gates (gate map ids validate, node, test) run in your worktree: `claude plugin validate <worktree>` (manifest + hooks), `node --no-warnings --import ./tests/node/register.mjs tests/node/run.mjs` (the pure suite, must stay all green), `claude plugin test <worktree>` (the engine suite; if it refuses with 'rollout switch served off', retry twice over a minute, then record 'suite owed' and rely on validate + the node suite). Type-check with tsc 5.x if one is on PATH; there is no package.json. Red first: add the failing test under tests/ (engine) or tests/node/ (pure) before the fix. Hooks stay thin: pure logic in hooks/lib/, every $ call in hooks/register.ts. Never edit .claude-plugin/types/ (the engine writes it). Never touch ~/.claude or any other repo.
_evalCommand: What a background eval runner runs once per new origin/main sha when the session is idle; empty = no eval. Needs autoEval true here or in /config.
_delegateOnly: This repo is dogfooded by a Fable brain: an opus or fable brain may not edit source here; it writes cards (docs/cards/), .delegation/, this file, CHANGELOG.md and docs/, and dispatches the rest (GH-113).
_cardDir: This repo is itself a plugin: the engine reads agents/*.md as subagent definitions, so the cards live under docs/cards/ (GH-12, GH-100: docs/ keeps the repo root short).
